brief:
Israeli occupation forces distributed demolition notices Sunday to multiple Palestinian residences in Nahalin, a town situated west of Bethlehem in the southern occupied West Bank, Shehab Wire reported. The notices targeted homes belonging to Palestinian citizens in the area.

The action was documented by Al-Baddar, an organization focused on defending the rights of Bedouin communities. The distribution of demolition orders represents a continuation of Israeli practices in Palestinian areas, where such notices have been issued to numerous structures across the territory.
